outcome: guideline adherence for prevention of GBS disease
neonatal early onset Group B Streptococcal (EOGBS) disease
cohort: The study included a cohort of women with one or more risk factors for GBS disease, all culture-positive cases of GBS in babies aged 0-89 days, and stillbirths due to GBS in Northern Ireland.
finding: The incidence of EOGBS disease in Northern Ireland was 0.57/1000 live births, which is higher than the UK average, with maternal risk factors present in 55.8% of cases, and IAP administered in 42% of women with risk factors, not preventing all EOGBS cases.
